description: Gets placeholder setting assigned on an item.

database.description: The content database. Only sent when addressing by id -- a path carries its own database prefix (e.g. master:/sitecore/content/Home).

finalLayout.description: Specifies layout holding the placeholder setting. If 'true', the final layout is used, otherwise - shared layout.

id.description: The id of the item to get placeholder setting for. Supply this or path.

language.description: The language version of the item to retrieve placeholder setting for.

path.description: The path of the item to get placeholder setting for. Supply this or id.

name: presentation-get-placeholder-setting
